title: Balance text intent with spatial control
description: Choose a visual brief, add a structural signal, and tune guidance. Watch alignment, composition, variation, and conflict move for different reasons.

controls.label: Text only
controls.detail: Maximum compositional freedom, but prose alone may not fix exact geometry.

controls.label: Edge map
controls.detail: Constrains outlines and placement while leaving depth and material interpretation open.

controls.label: Depth map
controls.detail: Constrains near-far structure without prescribing every contour.

controls.label: Pose skeleton
controls.detail: Anchors body joints and orientation for a person-centered composition.

scenarios.label: Product still life
scenarios.prompt: A red ceramic teapot in front of a folded blue cloth, three-quarter studio view
scenarios.lesson: Depth can stabilize foreground-background structure without locking every edge.

scenarios.label: Spatial poster
scenarios.prompt: A blue bicycle to the left of a yellow bench on a clean poster background
scenarios.lesson: Explicit relations often need a spatial condition and a relation-focused evaluation slice.

scenarios.label: Character pose
scenarios.prompt: A dancer leaning forward with the right arm raised, full body, simple stage
scenarios.lesson: Pose conditioning anchors joints; the prompt still controls clothing, scene, and style.
